bullets: On Wednesday 11 November, DLD recorded 480 sales worth AED 1.4bn, down 4.2 percent from a typical weekday.
Off-plan properties made up 58.3 percent of sales, compared to 57.6 percent over the last seven days.
The median price was AED 1,742 per sq ft, up 4.3 percent against the 30-day average and down 3.5 percent from last year.
JVC led 7-day sales with 198 transactions, followed by Dubai South with 146 and Dubai Land Residence with 130.
In October new contracts, JVC one-bedroom apartments had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, rising 1.2 percent on the month.
talking_points: A Dubai court recently ordered fraudsters to refund Dh4.7 Million, which highlights legal protections against residency fraud.
Emaar malls and hotels were hit by regional conflict, showing how geopolitical tensions can directly impact Dubai's retail and hospitality sectors.
Arada and Alya teamed up for a $1.63bn pipeline, signaling significant new luxury project pipelines and cross-border investment activity.
